'''Gerrit "Ger" Klein''' (4 September 1925 – 9 December 1998) was a Dutch politician of the [[Labour Party (Netherlands)|Labour Party (PvdA)]] and professor of physics.<ref name="trouw">{{cite news |title=Ger Klein overleden - Na aanvaring met Den Uyl knapte er iets |url=https://www.trouw.nl/voorpagina/ger-klein-overleden-na-aanvaring-met-den-uyl-knapte-er-iets~b9a2ad70/ |access-date=13 February 2026 |work=Trouw |date=10 December 1998 |language=nl |trans-title=Ger Klein has passed away - After a clash with Den Uyl, something snapped}}</ref>
